Resource_Provisioner.message: PROVISIONER STATUS: No deficits reported network-wide. Both General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center hold surpluses of all resource types (IV_Kits, PPE_Sets, Anesthetics, Surgical_Packs, Pain_Killers, Radio_Contrast, Oxygen_Tanks). No transfers will be executed — cross-hospital transfers between two surplus hospitals only shift holding costs and earn no transfer reward. All departments: proceed with scheduling from your job queues; request via broadcast ONLY if an actual deficit emerges for a scheduled patient, and I will transfer immediately to prevent resource failures.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Both hospitals report surplus of every resource and no one has requested transfers. Transferring surplus-to-surplus provides no reward and doesn't reduce net holding cost. Broadcasting a hold order prevents wasteful transfer requests and confirms I stand ready to move resources instantly if a real deficit appears.
